messages:
alisa: Quick sync: I ran the live preview for Console > Presets and found two issues: 1) the embed preview is 403 (CSP) in the preview environment, 2) several tracing examples still use `trace_id`. Filed failing preview: https://github.com/redwood-repo/docs/pull/868 (preview logs attached).
eng-bot: Deploy preview error: embed blocked by CSP header `frame-ancestors 'none'` from preview.host. Docs linter: `DeprecatedMetricError: field 'total_tokens' used`
sam: I can take the tracing snippet edits. Which files need changes?
alisa: primary spots: docs/console/presets.md, docs/console/examples/embed-dashboard.html, docs/observability/tracing-hooks.md. Also an old TypeScript snippet in examples/track.ts still logs `total_tokens`.
junaid: For the CSP 403, preview host adds stricter headers. We used to rely on a small shim at `https://static.redwood.dev/embed-shim.html` to proxy content into an allowed host. That shim isn't configured in preview. I can add a fallback: switch example to use the inline playground iframe with `sandbox` attributes for preview only.
docs-qa: Suggested quick checklist: - replace `trace_id` -> `tracehex` in py/ts snippets - update prose to call out tokens_in/tokens_out where metric examples appear - remove `total_tokens` references - change embed example to preview-safe iframe shim (and add a note) - run preview smoke tests
sam: I'll patch the snippets (py + ts) and the tracing-hooks doc. Example change for TS: `await console.logEvent({ event: 'render', tracehex: 'f3a1c4', tokens_in: 10, tokens_out: 32 })`
alisa: For the HTML embed, can we add a dev-only patch like: `<!-- preview-only: use sandboxed iframe to avoid CSP -->` and switch src to `/embed-shim.html?src=...` so production uses the real CDN?
junaid: yes, I'll make the shim available on preview host and add nginx rule. Might need 1-2 hours ops time. I'll post an infra PR and coordinate rollback if needed.
docs-qa: after PRs, I'll run the preview checklist and validate that the console playground loads the example, csv table uses tokens_in/out, and no `trace_id` remains.
sam: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-repo/docs/pull/872 with: - TS + Python snippet updates - tracing-hooks doc edits + migration note - removed `total_tokens` occurrences in presets.md - embed switched to preview shim when DEPLOY_ENV=preview
eng-bot: CI status: PR 872  docs build: passed, lint: passed, preview: https://deploy.preview/redwood/872 (embed shim pending infra change)
junaid: infra PR 44 created to add shim: https://github.com/redwood-repo/infra/pull/44. Will ping ops to approve.
maria: Thanks @sam and @junaid. Once infra PR merges, @docs-qa please run smoke tests and post results. Also add a short note to the docs backlog to grep for `total_tokens` and `trace_id` across the repo.
docs-qa: smoke tests queued. Found one remaining `trace_id` in `examples/legacy-logs.md` (commented) — filed as comment on PR 872.
sam: fixed legacy-logs.md in a follow-up commit on PR 872. Pushed.
junaid: infra PR merged, shim deployed to preview host at /embed-shim.html.
eng-bot: Preview for PR 872 re-rendered: embed loads, iframe sandbox present, no CSP errors.
_docs-qa_: Smoke tests: previews render, playground embed loads, dashboards show tokens_in/tokens_out columns, all snippets updated. Left two minor wording nits on the migration note.
maria: I'll address the nits, then merge. Great cross-team work, folks :tada:
eng-bot: Merged PR #872 by sam  production deploy started (sha fedcba9)
alisa: Follow-up action: add an automated grep job to the docs CI to flag `trace_id` and `total_tokens` usage so we don't regress. Filing ticket in docs backlog.
eng-bot: Production deploy completed at 2026-03-12T09:11:02Z
